requirements.statement: calendar_store and calendar_replay shall provide double-buffered 1024x13-bit replay with a registered two-stage calendar path and atomic slot-zero activation.
requirements.resolution_rationale: Separates inactive loading from active replay while preserving compiled slot ownership.
requirements.upstream_compliance: Implements the Arch-A calendar contract without changing entry fields or capacity.

acceptance_criteria.description: `make -C bfm test_calendars` loads calendar-export/v1 broadcast and gather vectors and scores every encoded ingress/mask terminal delivery.
The loader rejects duplicate router/slot entries and out-of-range slot, port, mask, or opcode fields.

requirements.statement: vc_buffers, xy_route, switch_alloc, crossbar, and credit_fc shall implement a credited X-then-Y BG/escape RC-to-SA-to-ST pipeline with a protected one-in-16 BG slot and bounded queues.
requirements.resolution_rationale: Keeps calendar traffic zero-buffered while providing finite progress and full-rate granted links.
requirements.upstream_compliance: Uses the selected XY-DOR credited class and 16/20-flit provisions.

acceptance_criteria.description: `make -C bfm test` sends a BG flit from (0,0) to (2,0) east then ejects it exactly once.
`make -C bfm test_calendars` confirms calendar ejections use explicit H=7/V=9 link propagation and one-cycle PE ramps, with the measured makespan matching each exported vector.

requirements.statement: multicast_fork shall atomically commit all selected five-port mask copies or retain the flit and leaf mask until availability; accepted leaves are not replayed.
requirements.resolution_rationale: A commit register makes fault recovery lossless without a multicast dependency cycle.

rejected_alternatives.reason: can duplicate accepted leaves on recovery

acceptance_criteria.description: The broadcast and allgather calendar replay tests score exactly all selected multicast leaves, including local plus multiple directional fork outputs.

requirements.statement: combine_unit shall perform Tier-B lane-wise integer/bitwise operations over eight 64-bit lanes with exactly three calendar-reserved cycles; unsupported operations use PE Tier-A and DCA remains disabled.
requirements.resolution_rationale: The selected Tier-B implementation meets the frozen numeric contract without an FPU/DCA dependency.

rejected_alternatives.reason: disabled by the selected Trial-1 architecture

requirements.upstream_compliance: Matches the selected opcode, precision, identity, and latency contract.

acceptance_criteria.description: `make -C bfm test_calendars` replays reduce and allreduce calendars containing Tier-B COMBINE_ADD opcodes on converge paths and reports their opcode count and makespan.
Lane-wise numerical correctness, operand tags, and the three-cycle reservation pipeline are separately required Phase-4/5 tests; the Trial-1 calendar replay does not claim closure.

requirements.statement: watchdog_demote and the C BFM shall model a 32-cycle release-once demotion to escape XY, preserve the flit, instantiate all 48 routers, and report smoke makespan against the supplied 6x8 baseline profile.
requirements.resolution_rationale: A cycle-driven portable BFM reuses the RefC behavior and provides deterministic Phase-4 comparison logs.

rejected_alternatives.reason: SystemC availability is not assumed for Trial 1

requirements.upstream_compliance: Retains all fixed mesh and watchdog timing parameters.

acceptance_criteria.description: `make -C bfm test` preserves the watchdog-demotion smoke behavior.
`make -C bfm test_calendars` replays all five collective tags with H=7/V=9 link timing and compares measured to vector makespan.
